head_xai.flag: op is FILED: SpaceX Q3'26 earnings release (8-K Ex. 99.1) 'Nameplate compute' 1.7 GW at 9/30/26 (1.4 GW at 6/30/26; 0.6 GW a year earlier); per the Q2'26 10-Q that is installed GPUs x all-in draw, excl. cooling/facility overhead ~= critical-IT. con = CFO-stated year-end floor (2.5 GW) less filed op; plan = Southaven Bldg 3. Now SpaceX's AI segment (SPCX listed 6/12/26); sells compute to third parties (Anthropic, Google) besides captive Grok — Musk targets a ~50/50 internal/rented split, rented on short contracts at spot-like rates.
head_xai.pipe: 2.5–3 GW nameplate compute by YE2026 ('nearly 2.2 gigawatts' at end-October, '2.5 to 3 gigawatts' by end-Q4, CFO Q3'26 call 10/20; was 'over two gigawatts' on the Q2 call); 2027: '10 gigawatts incremental next year, so 13 total' (Musk, 'highly confident'), with a plan for +20 GW of power/cooling next year (~23 GW, 'difficult but not impossible'); 440k Vera Rubin training cluster by end-Q2'27; Solaris 1.1 GW turbines by Q2 2027
head_xai.ndflag: no segment balance sheet — SpaceX (public since 6/12/26) reports AI as a segment only; nd null. valuation_b 250 = xAI's Feb-2026 merger mark, now STALE inside a public parent (SpaceX ~$85.7B net IPO proceeds; $25B bond deal; $60B Cursor merger closed 8/14/26)

econ.backlog: $14.1B Cloud Services Agreements contracted sales (Q2'26 release; non-cancellable period only) — the Q3'26 release gives no CSA figure though more CSAs were signed in Q3; company-wide backlog $63B at 9/30/26 (from $47.5B at 6/30), not split by segment; CSAs terminable on 90 days' notice after an initial period
econ.capexmw: SI capex $16.4B Q3'26 / $40.0B 9M'26 (Q2 $15.8B) while nameplate rose 1.4→1.7 GW; total-company Q4'26 capex guided to $35–40B for the Q4 ramp; earlier ~$18B for 555k GPUs on Colossus 2 (~$32M/MW-equiv, GPU-incl.)
econ.anchor: captive (xAI/Grok-5 training at Colossus II) + Anthropic (~325k GPUs across Colossus + Colossus II, $1.25B/month through May 2029, per 424B4) + Google (CSA signed 6/5/26: $920M/month Oct 2026–Jun 2029 per SpaceX filing as reported; ramp confirmed on Q2'26 call; ~110k GPUs press-only) + undisclosed hosting customers ($6.7B over 6 months from Oct 2026, contracted early Q3; ~$1.11B/month from 12/1/26, closed Sep 2026) + further CSAs 'signed ... during the quarter' (Q3'26 release, counterparties not named); CSAs are ~90-day + 90-day-out commits
econ.power: Southaven gas JV w/ Solaris (50.1/49.9); 7x35 MW turbines live, 1.1 GW by Q2'27; MLGW grid + on-site gas; SpaceX casting its own turbine blades and vanes (Musk, Q3'26 call)
econ.pricing: reserved compute via Cloud Services Agreements (~$1.25B/mo Anthropic); CFO Q3'26: pricing 'slightly above the high end of the $30 to $50 per watt range', payback under a year; Musk: renewals at higher $/W
